name: Asset-batiment
label: Bâtiment / Localisation
__comment: HMD-specific field on the ERPNext core 'Asset' DocType: links a machine to its housing/building via the existing HMD 'Batiment' master. French snake_case fieldname per references/conventions.md §2. Because 'Asset' is not in HMD_DOCTYPES, this CF must be exported BY NAME (see hooks_fixtures_snippet.py) or it is wiped on bench migrate — same gotcha as Stock Entry-id_lot (SCRUM-123).
